caption: Ardleigh estate entrance off the L4202. Cut limestone pillars with a carved nameplate and topiary Box planters either side, with gorgeous mature trees in the background. A lovely formal welcome into the estate (May 2026)

Looking out from inside Ardleigh past the gateposts toward the L4202. The combination of cut-stone pillars, painted ironwork and topiary planters gives the entrance the same formal feel coming and going (May 2026)

A flowering Whitebeam in full cream blossom on the footpath outside Ardleigh, on the L4202 walking back toward the village. Whitebeam is a great early-summer street tree, with the cream blossom now and bright red berries in autumn that the thrushes go mad for (May 2026)
